config.name: causely-sweep
config.prompt:
[causely-sweep]
Sweep active Causely issues and investigate the ones nobody has handled yet.

Only consider issues whose current severity is High or Critical.
Follow the sweep procedure in the causely-investigation skill: list with get_issues, skip what the ledger or scope rules out, investigate up to the per-sweep limit from your deployment policy, record each outcome in the ledger, and end with one OUTCOME block per issue plus the SWEEP_SUMMARY block.
